20:35 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NBA Basketball
The Thunder host the Timberwolves in NBA Western Conference play at Paycom Center. Oklahoma City sit tenth in the West at 10-8 after losing four of their last five, while Minnesota arrive third at 13-5 and winners of four of five.

23:05 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NBA Basketball
The Trail Blazers host the Spurs in NBA Western Conference play at Moda Center. First in the West at 15-3, San Antonio have won nine of their last ten; Portland enter at 11-6 after a road win over Philadelphia.
